dependencies.measurement: one forward per tagged key through ri.run_arm: a plain run through pm.capture_prompt, an edit through pm.run_patched (REPLACE at RESID_PRE.L3@p_c with the float32 cast of the float64 edit, or at L03.H04@p_t for a head arm); the capture set of ri.capture_sites; Δc(arm) = mean over the scorable nouns of NounSet.contrasts(arm) − NounSet.contrasts(REF), both from stage 2
dependencies.table: per frame and cue w, from the frame's reference state (rd.state_from_locked) and the weights alone: rows16 = ul.reference_rows_017; ctx = ul.pair_context(progs, frame, state, reference id, id_w, w, rows16); Δx̂3 = ul.compose_dx3(progs, ctx, b0c.P1_MASK['coordinated']) (023's completed program, mask 30); the program's own Δr̂, read part, û_off and ŝ from Δx̂3(p_c) by the measurement's formula; each main arm's change at both p_c and p_t (explicit float64 zeros) as design §5 tabulates; Δĉ = ul.contrast_of (020's frozen readout), the scorable nouns in the listed order; the fractions with fractions_for_weak off

geometry.u_off_rule: per pair at run time, from the plain runs of the same frame: Δx = x_w − x_ref at RESID_PRE.L3, p_c; Δr = ⟨Δx, w_c⟩; read = (Δr/⟨w_c, w_c⟩)·w_c; off_c = (Δx − read) − mean(Δx − read)·𝟙; û_off = off_c/‖off_c‖; s = |Δr|/‖w_c‖ (design §2, §14 D2)

table: any gate fails, or an incident is recorded
R and I pass, D fails
R, I and D pass, P is uninformative
R, I and D pass, P fails
R, I, D and P pass

families.D: A_amp = Δc(NEC-AMP) − Δc_full < 0 and A_neg = Δc(SUF-NEG) > 0: doubling the read change adds plural shift, reversing it adds singular preference, the opposite of disruption
families.I: S_f = F_ins − F_ins_off > 0: installing the read part produces more of the shift than an equal-length off-read installation
families.P: |F̂_rem − F_rem| ≤ max(τ_rem, 0.02) and |F̂_ins − F_ins| ≤ max(τ_ins, 0.02), the program's table committed before any target prompt
families.R: N_f = F_rem_off − F_rem > 0: the read removal takes away more of the shift than an equal-length off-read removal

semantics.gates: G4 is an integrity gate, not an outcome filter: a gate failure after the measurements stops outcome scoring and is reviewed under the incident procedure; no frame is dropped, replaced or selectively ignored; no tolerance is widened by calibration or changed after target results exist

hierarchy.generalization: does the effect extend to three and many? Secondary only; the stratum cannot rescue a failed primary result
hierarchy.head_not_supported: if the primary passes but the head-only evidence does not support the head: the decoded residual direction is causal at this site, within the scope, but its effect cannot be assigned uniquely to L03.H04
hierarchy.primary: does manipulating the decoded read direction at the cue-position residual causally alter the one/two singular–plural choice in new coordinated frames? Answered by R, I and D against the matched non-read control, with the labels above
hierarchy.secondary: is L03.H04 specifically the component that mediates the effect? The head-only arms answer it descriptively; they cannot change the primary label

semantics.incidents: an incident carries no result; the report then renders NOT_INTERPRETABLE
non_claims: no label says that the component is unused, or that it has no causal role
no label assigns the effect to L03.H04 alone: the residual edit reaches every component that reads it
no label generalizes beyond the one/two pair, this site, this checkpoint and these frames
semantics.order: R and I by Holm at 0.025 on the two count p-values alone (exact binomial tails under a symmetric sign); a family passes when Holm rejects its count and its median is at least 0.05, and a failed floor does not change the other family's threshold; D only if R and I pass; P only if D passes; a family not reached is reported descriptively and cannot change the label
semantics.scope: the read component of the residual entering layer 3 at the cue position, as every reader of that residual sees it, in coordinated frames, for the cue pair one/two from which the read was estimated
semantics.secondary: the stratum, the isotropic controls, the head arms, the midpoint, PC-SWAP, the additivity, the manipulation check, the LayerNorm records and every bootstrap interval are computed after the result is written and can never rescue, alter or redefine it
semantics.weak: a frame whose Δc_full exceeds −1 nat counts as a failure in every count, enters every median as the worst value, and is excluded from the direction-free summaries with its count; ties count as failures

stage1.freeze: written once at stage 1 directly at these paths, with their digests in the stage-1 record; committed by the user before confirm; the barrier re-reads them, checks their digests, the layout and the metadata, and recomputes the table bit for bit before any S2 key

meta.construction: rd.locked_state of each S1-REF capture (rd.capture_frame_020), float64; rebuilt with rd.state_from_locked

table.construction: per frame and cue w, from the frame's reference state (rd.state_from_locked) and the weights alone: rows16 = ul.reference_rows_017; ctx = ul.pair_context(progs, frame, state, reference id, id_w, w, rows16); Δx̂3 = ul.compose_dx3(progs, ctx, b0c.P1_MASK['coordinated']) (023's completed program, mask 30); the program's own Δr̂, read part, û_off and ŝ from Δx̂3(p_c) by the measurement's formula; each main arm's change at both p_c and p_t (explicit float64 zeros) as design §5 tabulates; Δĉ = ul.contrast_of (020's frozen readout), the scorable nouns in the listed order; the fractions with fractions_for_weak off

statistics.bootstrap: one [10,000 × 36] index matrix from torch.Generator().manual_seed(20261001) and torch.randint, shared by every median; the interval is the 250th and the 9,750th of the sorted resampled medians
statistics.direction_free: the midpoint and PC-SWAP fractions, the additivity and P's errors exclude weak frames, with their count
statistics.fractions: F_rem = Δc(NEC-READ)/Δc_full, F_rem_off = Δc(NEC-OFF)/Δc_full, F_ins = Δc(SUF-READ)/Δc_full, F_ins_off = Δc(SUF-OFF)/Δc_full, A_amp = Δc(NEC-AMP) − Δc_full, A_neg = Δc(SUF-NEG); a weak frame's fractions are not computed at confirm
statistics.head_counts: the head arms' counts (descriptive): F_head_rem < 1 and F_head_rem_v < 1 (the head-only removal leaves less than the full shift), F_head_ins > 0 and F_head_ins_v > 0 (the head-only installation produces some of it); weak frames fail; the shares are reported only under their guards, a guard-excluded frame counted and left out
statistics.holm: exact binomial tails as Fractions; Holm at 1/40 on the two count p-values alone (the smaller against 1/80, the larger against 1/40)
statistics.median: the middle value for odd n; the mean of the n/2-th and (n/2 + 1)-th sorted values for even n (18th and 19th of 36); the mean of an infinite and a finite value is the infinite one
statistics.strict: N_f > 0, S_f > 0, A_amp < 0, A_neg > 0 strictly; ties fail; the precondition counts Δc_full ≤ −1; P agrees when both errors are ≤ max(τ, 0.02); medians pass at ≥ 0.05; counts pass at ≥ the threshold; P is not evaluable when τ_rem or τ_ins > 0.20
statistics.worst: a weak frame enters a median as its worst value: −∞ for N, S, A_neg, F_head_ins, the head shares and the isotropic margins; +∞ for A_amp and F_head_rem
